description: A floor-length muted burgundy court dress with a low square neckline and fitted opaque bodice. Gold decorative borders define the neckline, front panels, elbow-length sleeves and skirt opening. A cream patterned inner skirt is visible between the long front outer panels. A cream woven-looking wrap rests over both lower arms and hangs at the sides, edged with burgundy and gold trim. A gold-patterned waist belt has a red jewel-like central ornament. A small red pendant necklace, drop earrings and patterned dark footwear are visible. Material fibres are uncertain; the fabric appears textured and substantial.
